Will Dogecoin Price Be Boosted by Elon Musk's New Job?
Dogecoin, created as a joke in 2013 and supported by Elon Musk, has seen an 88% increase in value following Donald Trump's election victory.

and Ether, Solana, and Dogecoin rising by 4.4% and 5.4% respectively. The positive trend in crypto prices is partly influenced by the prospect of lower interest rates making riskier investments like cryptocurrencies more appealing to investors.
